description: This file defines types, classes, and functions for managing session registry in Playwright, including loading, storing, and retrieving session data, as well as handling client info and session naming.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Manages session files, allowing loading, retrieval, and updating session entries based on client info and session name.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session file by client info and session name.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Retrieves all session files associated with the given client info.

methods.name: entryMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of session files.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a session entry from disk and updates the registry.

methods.name: _loadSessionEntry
methods.description: Private static method to load a session file from disk.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to load all session files from the base daemon directory.
